granite-switch-4.1-30b.code_revision: COMPOSED CHECKPOINT, DECISION ADAPTER: ibm-granite/granite-switch-4.1-30b at eb206725d03c0f1c409ce3aa512afe325fdf8731, identified by its card as revision 4.1.1. The composed checkpoint, not a base-plus-adapter recomposition or direct PEFT substitute, ran with the author Granite Switch vLLM plugin from generative-computing/granite-switch at 43ccd291a176507ae4ed5af293f8f2d947c0d451. A first-party dist-info marker registers the exact read-only plugin source without running author build scripts. The selected adapter is decision; Guardian and speech-to-text were not evaluated. Audio limit zero and skip-mm-profiling prevent the optional ASR route from loading; only plain string text reaches the backend. Composer and tutorial subtrees were excluded from the runtime mount. Source review and isolation do not constitute a full independent audit of every upstream/custom kernel. FIRST-PARTY WIRE SHIM: frozen System One requests are translated to local stock vLLM chat completions using the composed serving recipe: no system prompt, then a State: user turn and a ### DECISION user turn with the whole question, ordered option descriptions and Reply with exactly one option label. The author Decision Index recipe includes a fixed system prompt and is a different recipe. The shim reads raw first-generated-position label logprobs, not the sampled answer token. Explicit label reads are split into chunks of at most 128 IDs on the identical full prompt and joined by one stable global softmax; choice argmax, Noul P(true) and ordered score expectation use those probabilities. All actual prompt and generated tokens from every chunk are billed in native usage. No prompt truncation, permutation averaging, response repair or scored retry. MEASURED STACK: stock vLLM 0.30.0, Torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.17.0, tokenizers 0.23.3, Triton 3.7.1, BF16, max-num-seqs=1, chunked prefill=2048 and gpu-memory-utilization=0.90. Attention backend was explicitly TRITON_ATTN; FlashInfer sampling, all-reduce and autotune were disabled before sealed use to avoid the unavailable nvcc path. This declared backend selection can change roundoff/performance relative to automatic selection; no cross-backend numerical equivalence is claimed. The probability readout, labels, native attention formula, weights and dtype were not changed. A local dev-RPC memory observer reads peak CUDA allocator memory only; it does not alter model tensors or probabilities, and the shim cannot proxy that route. Runtime/source and tokenizer hashes were verified before protected staging. Upstream wheels were hash-locked; Debian libgomp1 12.2.0-14+deb12u1 and libnuma1 2.0.16-1 were recorded. Author/model execution occurred only on a disposable rented pod with offline flags, empty credentials, read-only mounts, restricted capabilities and network-none isolation.

granite-switch-4.1-30b.disclosure: NEW DRAW: measured on 27 October 2026 draw; unranked until equating. 1,500 HTTP 200 responses, zero usage mismatches and native deviations; no scored retry, replacement or averaging. Source review is not a contamination audit or minimum-hardware guarantee. Disposable evaluator-owned Verda RTX PRO 6000 96 GB FIN-03 PAYG non-spot pod, offline flags, empty credentials, read-only mounts and network-none isolation. Exact VM/OS-volume absence and node/local private shreds verified; retained distinct-inode single-link mode0600 custody raw. Scoring, full breakdowns, equating and publication remain with release owner. Composed decision checkpoint with author Granite Switch plugin and first-party label-logprob wire shim; no system prompt, differing from the author Decision Index system-prompt recipe. TRITON_ATTN selected; FlashInfer sampling/all-reduce/autotune disabled. Raw first-position label logprobs, chunks of at most128 labels with a global softmax; all prompt and generated tokens from every chunk billed. Native output1 retained. REPLAY RECORD ONLY: 7/50 bit-identical, ONE argmax flip, maximum absolute probability difference 0.031222338329561394. No response repair or replacement; exact reproducibility is not established. Pre-registered public same-engine label re-extraction used 5e-2 absolute tolerance, exact label sets, own-winner consistency and a near-tie allowance; this is not cross-backend equivalence. Five requests exceeded10s and remain standard failures under the unchanged release rule. No native truncation/refusal.
